forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: Great point, Jamie. With over 1.2 million businesses on Azure, innovation can't stop. But this might spark a revolution for better security standards.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: Right, and it’s not just Azure. Google Cloud, AWS, others must take note. If Azure's vulnerable, who's next?

forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: So, Jamie, did you catch that latest rollout from Hippocratic AI? They just launched two new tools aimed at expanding clinical access and improving nurse workflow. This was published on April 20th, 2026, by Fierce Healthcare.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: It's a definite wake-up call. Isolated but raises alarms about system security. If a token flaw causes this much chaos, what else is slipping through?
